_note: v2.7 plan 39 row 37-Q3 (diff half), payload case group-away-notice (NOT YET RUN). Run ONLY through `node scripts/debug/so-payload-golden.mts capture` (see group-opening.json for the probe and the tripwire). Story: an inline copy of test/scenarios/v27-37-character-life.story.json (Arin's schedule puts her at the docks at night) with aliases: `the guide` only Arin carries, `my friend` Arin and the narrator share. Night at the market, so Arin is away. ST's dry run never opens the generation lifecycle (generationLifecycle.ts `started()` drops args[2] === true), and the away notice rides only an opened loud generation (wiring/generation.ts `opened` -> awayNotice.opened), so every capture sits between a synthetic GENERATION_STARTED('normal', {}, false) and GENERATION_STOPPED (the emit_generation verb, no model call); the same wrapper around every capture keeps them comparable. Captures WITH one `story_orchestrator_away_notice` block (depth 0, the line once in the prompt): addressed-rest, addressed-dm (shared, not private: the drafted narrator sees it too), ooc-after-address-rest (an OOC line after the address is no turn), unique-alias-rest. Captures WITHOUT it: unaddressed-rest and shared-alias-rest (never set yet, so no block at all), docks-addressed-rest (party at the docks, Arin present: the control), unaddressed-after-rest (set once before, so ST keeps the key with an empty value; the prompt text carries no away line). The cross-case half of the row (byte-identical to a chat without schedules) is the diff of these captures against the baseline goldens, not a within-case assertion. Not expressed here: the reply not speaking as Arin (RP tier) and quiet/impersonate never carrying it (jest `runtime/awayNotice.test.ts`).

requires.why: a fixed cast state at the start of every capture, scripted turns only, and no judge request
